generic_policy: docs/workflows/validation_freeze_lifecycle_v1.md §5 remains first valid fully measured accepted/frozen cohort per-phase; does not name Day 4

baseline_selection.source: Day 4 N750 Step 8 real measured phases
baseline_selection.rationale: Day 2 C300 did not retain one complete comparable end-to-end timing; choose real observed Day 4 granular evidence for project pilot instead of inventing missing Day 2 values
baseline_selection.phase_method: Local monotonic elapsed for remote resolution and local CLEAN; SQL local request-to-result intervals (not Spark executor time). Derived SQL total is nonoverlapping sum, not an end-to-end run.

local CLEAN build and result readback

only equivalent SQL coverage and lineage phase
phase_limits.description: SQL source coverage and lineage request-to-result

phase_limits.scope: not a separate job; only when same four SQL phases are complete; not full end-to-end processing
phase_limits.description: derived nonoverlapping sum of four SQL phase request-to-result intervals

applicability.pilot_day5_and_later: Use numeric reference at future project runs for matching phase operations. Compare and record actual phase definition, data volume, source family mix, runtime, source reuse/upload ratio and processing/model operations; expose noncomparable characteristics as explicit pilot caveats. The project owner accepts this provisional numeric yardstick for bounded experimentation, not as proof of production scale invariance.
applicability.no_existing_phase: Do not invent a threshold or claim C3.4 PASS. Measure and seek a separate first-stage owner-approved baseline for a genuinely new processing, historical backfill/replay or end-to-end phase.
applicability.run_readiness: This config does not itself issue a Databricks write grant, increase job timeouts, or authorize exceeding any separately signed runtime budget.
applicability.comparison_aggregation: Each phase is assessed independently. The four-SQL-phase total is a derived cross-check only when all four intervals were measured on the same basis; not additive to those already measured phases.

outcomes.pass: measured time <= 5x baseline, and no stricter signed grant or job cap breached
outcomes.pass_warning: 5x < measured time <= 10x: performance warning retained and visible, but C3.4 technical result PASS and workflow continues within other grants
outcomes.block: measured time > 10x: C3.4 BLOCKED; hold result promotion and obtain separate human decision before relaxing budget or continuing beyond allowed cap
outcomes.unresolved: missing measured reference/time or structurally unmatched work: no automatic C3.4 PASS; independent bootstrap needed

historical_integrity.day4_c3_4_result: BLOCKED historically; never change to PASS
historical_integrity.original_day4_approval_scope: N750-like comparable workloads only, preserved in original file
known_limitations: Day 4 reference is not single end-to-end C1500 runtime
Phase elapsed time not internal Spark executor wall
